sources.finding: kraal is a Linux/macOS terminal multiplexer, installed as one binary. It supports simultaneous coding-agent panes, per-agent attention states, Git worktrees, SSH connections and persistent sessions.

sources.title: kraal docs/workspaces.md
sources.finding: Sessions continue after terminal detach/window closure. Closing a session or a server restart stops processes; compatible known Claude/Codex conversations can be reopened. Persistence is not proof that local work survives laptop sleep.
